posts.text: “Good morning. It’s Monday. It’s very very foggy out there. You have to be very careful about the fog because the mean dogs can hide in it. But remember I’m an English spring spaniel and the English invented fog, so I’m ok. Also, I love you.”

Of course it does.

Note: when I said this last night, I did not mean like three paces past a metal detector. From what I’ve seen today, security did its job and the system worked.


Jonah Goldberg (@JonahDispatch)

If someone really got a gun past the metal detectors, that’s a really big deal. There are very few spaces in DC that the secret service has protected for more years and more thoroughly than this ballroom. But I’m not buying anything we hear for now.
